description: Create an OpenRouter key (hundreds of models, any OpenAI-compatible client at https://openrouter.ai/api/v1) and save it into the application as OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Then `redeploy` so the running app picks it up. The secret is not returned here: it is in the application's environment, which is where it belongs, and out of this transcript. A key on an empty wallet is disabled until the user tops it up.

name.description: A label for the key, like chatbot.
